To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
aminated polystyrere is an effective support for Rh catalysts in the water gas reaction.
aminated polymers have a great potential to be used as a support for the WGSPR.
aminated polystylrene-bound Rh catalysts are active and selective in the water gas reaction and that the aminated polymer is an efficient support for Rh catalysts.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of aminated polystylrenes and their use as a solid support for Rh6 (CO)16 in the WGSR.
the development of new catalysts for the WGSR and the study of the mechanism of this important reaction.
the preparation, characterization, and use of aminated polystylrene-bound Rh6(CO)(16) catalysts for the WGSR.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the aminated polystylrenes are effective supports for the WGSR.
Rh6(CO)(amine)(polymer) is the best catalyst for WGSR and that the aminated polystylrene is the best support.
the WGSR activity is independent of the polymer support.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the aminated polystylrene-bound Rh cluster catalysts are very effective for the WGSR, and the catalysts are very easy to handle, and are reusable.
the WGSR is not catalyzed by the aminated polystyrere-bound Rh complex but is catalyzed by a soluble Rh species formed by leaching of the aminated polysterene-bound Rh complex.
amination of chloromethyl polystyrene is an effective method to prepare a support for Rh6 (CO)16 catalysts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the support can be aminated with various amines to give polymers with different basicities and different degrees of cross-linking.
aminated polymers can be effective supports for Rh6(Co)16 in the WGSR.
the support can be used to control the selectivity of the reaction.
